question: Should LongCat ship as a bundled provider in this PR, start as an official external/ClawHub provider, or remain a documented custom-provider setup for now?
rationale: The provider SDK can express the integration, but VISION.md keeps optional bundled plugins behind a high bar while also prioritizing major model providers; the PR therefore needs maintainer ownership/product direction before merge.

options.title: Bundle after live proof
options.body: Accept this PR's bundled provider direction after maintainer confirmation and a successful LongCat-key live generation/tool-call validation run.

options.title: Publish externally first
options.body: Move LongCat to an official external provider package discoverable through ClawHub, keeping core lean while preserving native onboarding once installed.

options.title: Keep custom setup only
options.body: Close or pause the bundled-provider work and rely on documented custom provider configuration until demand or ownership is clearer.

recommendation.title: Bundle after live proof
recommendation.body: Accept this PR's bundled provider direction after maintainer confirmation and a successful LongCat-key live generation/tool-call validation run.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc owns the linked maintainer issue and authored the current provider implementation plus recent adjacent provider work.
